```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(svglite)
library(yaml)
source("oeda_themes.R")
source("oeda_plotly_themes.R")
```


# Static Plots

## ggplot

Themes are found in the `oeda_themes.R` file contained in this repository. Using a themes file allows us to make multiple plot themes and apply them consistently in a given situation. In this plot, the color values have been manually applied based on the `_brand.yml` colors.

::: callout-note
### SVG Rendering

This approach uses the `svglite` package to take the generated ggplots and convert them to scalable vector graphics (SVGs). This makes it possible to resize the screen and have the ggplots dynamically respond.
:::

```{r scatter-plot}
#| echo: true

scatter_example <- ggplot(mtcars, aes(x = wt, y = mpg, color = factor(cyl))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, linewidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Vehicle Fuel Efficiency Analysis",
    subtitle = "Weight vs MPG colored by cylinder count",
    x = "Weight (1000 lbs)",
    y = "Miles per gallon", 
    color = "Cylinders",
    caption = "Data: Motor Trend Car Road Tests"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#2E3192", "#86C679", "#A91F50"))
```

```{r render-scatter-plot}
#| fig-cap: "Fig. 1: Vehicle efficiency analysis"
#| renderings: [light, dark]

scatter_example + theme_oeda_light()
scatter_example + theme_oeda_dark()
```

# Interactive Plots

## Plotly

Plotly is the recommended choice for generating html interactive plots. 


```{r prepare-plotly-data}
# Prepare the mtcars data
cars_data <- mtcars %>%
  mutate(
    car_name = rownames(mtcars),
    cyl_factor = factor(cyl, levels = c(4, 6, 8),
                        labels = c("4 cylinders", "6 cylinders", "8 cylinders"))
  )
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Fuel Efficiency

```{r plotly-scatterplot}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
# Create an interactive scatter plot
plot_ly(
  data = cars_data,
  x = ~wt,
  y = ~mpg,
  color = ~cyl_factor,
  colors = oeda_colors_cool[1:3],
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 10, opacity = 0.8),
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>", car_name, "</b><br>",
    "Weight: ", round(wt, 2), " (1000 lbs)<br>",
    "MPG: ", mpg, "<br>",
    "Cylinders: ", cyl, "<br>",
    "Horsepower: ", hp
  ),
  hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
) %>%
  layout_oeda_light(
    title = "Vehicle Fuel Efficiency Analysis",
    subtitle = "Weight vs MPG by Engine Type"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Weight (1000 lbs)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Miles per Gallon"),
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "Engine Type"),
      orientation = "v",
      x = 1.02,
      xanchor = "left",
      y = 1,
      yanchor = "top"
    )
  ) %>%
  config_oeda()

plot_ly(
  data = cars_data,
  x = ~wt,
  y = ~mpg,
  color = ~cyl_factor,
  colors = oeda_colors_cool[1:3],
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 10, opacity = 0.8),
  text = ~paste0(
    "<b>", car_name, "</b><br>",
    "Weight: ", round(wt, 2), " (1000 lbs)<br>",
    "MPG: ", mpg, "<br>",
    "Cylinders: ", cyl, "<br>",
    "Horsepower: ", hp
  ),
  hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
) %>%
  layout_oeda_dark(
    title = "Vehicle Fuel Efficiency Analysis",
    subtitle = "Weight vs MPG by Engine Type"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Weight (1000 lbs)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Miles per Gallon"),
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "Engine Type"),
      orientation = "v",
      x = 1.02,
      xanchor = "left",
      y = 1,
      yanchor = "top"
    )
  ) %>%
  config_oeda()
```

### Average by Cylinder
```{r plotly-barchart}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
# Calculate averages
avg_mpg <- cars_data %>%
  group_by(cyl_factor) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_mpg = mean(mpg),
    se = sd(mpg) / sqrt(n()),
    count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create bar chart
plot_ly(
  data = avg_mpg,
  x = ~cyl_factor,
  y = ~avg_mpg,
  type = "bar",
  marker = list(
    color = oeda_colors_warm[1:3],
    line = list(color = "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)", width = 1)
  ),
  error_y = list(
    type = "data",
    array = ~se,
    color = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)"
  ),
  text = ~paste0(round(avg_mpg, 1), " mpg<br>(n=", count, ")"),
  textposition = "outside",
  hovertemplate = paste0(
    "<b>%{x}</b><br>",
    "Average MPG: %{y:.1f}<br>",
    "Sample size: %{customdata}<br>",
    "Standard error: ±%{error_y.array:.2f}",
    "<extra></extra>"
  ),
  customdata = ~count
) %>%
  layout_oeda_light(
    title = "Average Fuel Efficiency by Engine Type",
    subtitle = "Error bars show standard error"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Engine Type"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average Miles per Gallon"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
  config_oeda()

plot_ly(
  data = avg_mpg,
  x = ~cyl_factor,
  y = ~avg_mpg,
  type = "bar",
  marker = list(
    color = oeda_colors_warm[1:3],
    line = list(color = "rgba(0,0,0,0.2)", width = 1)
  ),
  error_y = list(
    type = "data",
    array = ~se,
    color = "rgba(0,0,0,0.5)"
  ),
  text = ~paste0(round(avg_mpg, 1), " mpg<br>(n=", count, ")"),
  textposition = "outside",
  hovertemplate = paste0(
    "<b>%{x}</b><br>",
    "Average MPG: %{y:.1f}<br>",
    "Sample size: %{customdata}<br>",
    "Standard error: ±%{error_y.array:.2f}",
    "<extra></extra>"
  ),
  customdata = ~count
) %>%
  layout_oeda_dark(
    title = "Average Fuel Efficiency by Engine Type",
    subtitle = "Error bars show standard error"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Engine Type"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Average Miles per Gallon"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) %>%
  config_oeda()
```

### Horsepower Trends
```{r plotly-trend}
#| renderings: [light, dark]
# Create trend plot with LOESS smoothing
plot_ly(
  data = cars_data,
  x = ~hp,
  y = ~mpg,
  color = ~cyl_factor,
  colors = oeda_colors_primary[1:3],
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 10, opacity = 0.7),
  text = ~paste0("<b>", car_name, "</b><br>HP: ", hp, "<br>MPG: ", mpg),
  hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
) %>%
  add_lines(
    data = cars_data,
    x = ~hp,
    y = ~fitted(loess(mpg ~ hp)),
    color = ~cyl_factor,
    colors = oeda_colors_primary[1:3],
    line = list(width = 2),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    hoverinfo = "skip"
  ) %>%
  layout_oeda_light(
    title = "Horsepower vs Fuel Efficiency",
    subtitle = "Trend lines show LOESS smoothing by cylinder count"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Horsepower"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Miles per Gallon"),
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "Engine Type"),
      x = 0.98,
      xanchor = "right",
      y = 0.98,
      yanchor = "top"
    )
  ) %>%
  config_oeda()

plot_ly(
  data = cars_data,
  x = ~hp,
  y = ~mpg,
  color = ~cyl_factor,
  colors = oeda_colors_primary[1:3],
  type = "scatter",
  mode = "markers",
  marker = list(size = 10, opacity = 0.7),
  text = ~paste0("<b>", car_name, "</b><br>HP: ", hp, "<br>MPG: ", mpg),
  hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>"
) %>%
  add_lines(
    data = cars_data,
    x = ~hp,
    y = ~fitted(loess(mpg ~ hp)),
    color = ~cyl_factor,
    colors = oeda_colors_primary[1:3],
    line = list(width = 2),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    hoverinfo = "skip"
  ) %>%
  layout_oeda_dark(
    title = "Horsepower vs Fuel Efficiency",
    subtitle = "Trend lines show LOESS smoothing by cylinder count"
  ) %>%
  layout(
    xaxis = list(title = "Horsepower"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Miles per Gallon"),
    legend = list(
      title = list(text = "Engine Type"),
      x = 0.98,
      xanchor = "right",
      y = 0.98,
      yanchor = "top"
    )
  ) %>%
  config_oeda()
```
